findings.finding: Frozen Candidate #35 treatment nulls potential/adaptation only on ALL_NON_RECEPTOR_UNITS; the preserved non-receptor ledger begins at unit 16.
findings.impact: The surgical treatment does not directly modify the receptor population that receives the cue.

findings.finding: Preserved cue routing targets are [6,7], and the observed response contains only unit-6 and unit-7 spikes and cascade [6,7], with no ignition.
findings.impact: Observed spikes come from directly cued untreated receptor units; no treated-unit spike demonstrates a path from nulled state into the declared response.

findings.finding: The causal falsifier is the high-level response signature; treatment_state_hash is integrity-only and the reduction ledger is not itself the causal falsifier.
findings.impact: Subthreshold treatment effects can exist without entering the declared endpoint.

findings.finding: DELAYED_SHAM_32MS changes unit-7 threshold, excitatory drive and novelty while preserving the same two-unit cascade/no-ignition structure.
findings.impact: The declared response demonstrably collapses some state-dependent differences.

findings.finding: SHAM cue-driven receptor spikes have substantial threshold margin (unit6 drive ~0.8114 vs 0.46; unit7 drive ~0.9145 vs ~0.5592).
findings.impact: Direct cue response is not a sensitive assay of treated non-receptor state on this batch; ceiling/insensitivity remains plausible.
